source: Latest Internet Archive capture (HTTP 200) of each SEC URL, fetched as original bytes (id_) and checked against the CDX SHA-1 digest. SEC answers this project's declared user agent with HTTP 403 from GitHub Actions and from the developer machine (probe run 43477784386, 2026-11-14), so no request goes to SEC. The HTML's own dei:EntityCentralIndexKey and dei:DocumentType must match the candidate.
